Hi team \u2014 quick tech answers below (high level; happy to jump on the call with Rishi for deeper sizing):

1) Latency (typical in-region, measured p50/p95 for a 1k-token request, Redwood hosted with optimized kernels):
   - US (us-west region): p50 ~65ms, p95 ~150ms (warm cache, streaming enabled)
   - EU (eu-west region): p50 ~80ms, p95 ~180ms
   - APAC (ap-southeast region): p50 ~110ms, p95 ~220ms
   - Cross-region tail (user -> failover region): add ~60-120ms network + processing variance; recommend runbook to avoid hitting failover for steady traffic.

2) Throughput / concurrency: 
   - \"2k RPS across regions\" interpretation: if you need 2k aggregate across all regions, plan per-region capacity based on traffic split. If you need 2k per-region, that should be treated as a separate capacity commit.
   - Concurrency per GPU: for your 1k-token median requests we typically sustain ~40-60 concurrent streams per GPU instance (depends on model size & quantization). Exact numbers verified in perf tests.
   - Burst handling: we support autoscale + burst capacity (dedicated pools) with predictable warmup windows; for very spiky bursts we recommend a small buffer of reserved capacity + overflow to hosted pool.

3) Streaming first-token latency: Redwood measures streaming latency as time from request accept to first token bytes on the wire. In-region first-token times typically <120ms (US/EU), ~160ms APAC on typical models/sequence lengths. We can instrument a synthetic streaming test to validate <200ms for your UI.

4) Data residency & telemetry: 
   - We can provide region-scoped audit logs and telemetry retention controls in Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted accounts, we support EU-only processing with EU-hosted compute + logs retained in EU; for stricter requirements we recommend Private deployment (VPC + customer-managed KMS) where logs never leave the customer's control plane.

5) Test plan & measurement methodology: we'll run your staging workload (1k token avg, provided prompt set) with our perf harness capturing p50/p95, first-token streaming latency, p99 tail, concurrency, and KV-cache hit rates. We'll share the test artifacts and plots.

Action items:
- We'll prepare the perf test plan (attached) and a short SLO table per region.
- Rishi: can you confirm staging access and whether Finova will run the harness in your VPC or want Redwood to run a synthetic test against your staging endpoint?

Happy to take this on call Wed 09/15 at 10:00 CET \u2014 Marissa, please confirm.

Thanks,
